title: KĀLA-YANTRA v3 bootstrap launch input (relaunch plan v2.7 §7 bootstrap launches and launch qualification, §14 B-0c / B-1)
description: Everything the planner must have prepared and recorded before it launches one Wave B bootstrap job directly (no kyjob.sh, no dispatcher). A missing field refuses launch. This schema checks shape only. Not checked by this schema, and checked by fleet/kyboot.py check before any launch: the bootstrap manifest and its review receipt and the supervisor's own reviewed bytes (first: nothing else is examined when they fail); a job id short enough for its action ids; every path absolute and normalised; the worktree (never the shared checkout, always beneath the worktree root), its branch (never main or suvarna*) and base_sha; the four sha256 values (each is the SHA-256 of the named file's bytes - packet_sha256 here is the file digest, not the front-matter field of the same name); that the prompt holds the exact bytes of the card and of the packet; the empty MCP configuration; the scratch and state locations; the environment allowlist with JOB_SCRATCH and KY_SCRATCH; the forbidden launch flags; effort and turn cap per kind; the deadline; that card_path and mcp_config are manifest components; the qualification receipt of role and model and everything it binds; the program's version against claude_min_version (run only for the program that receipt binds); the item lock. A schema-valid launch input is therefore not a launchable one.

job_id.description: One safe path component: it names <KY_SCRATCH>/jobs/<job_id> and <KY_RUN>/jobs/<job_id>. Its action ids ACT-launch-<job_id> and ACT-submit-<job_id> must fit the 160 characters of an action id (schemas/action.json); kyboot.py refuses a job id whose action ids would not.

kind.description: The job kind; it sets the turn cap kyboot.py enforces (plan §7): BUILD 150, REWORK 100, VERIFY 60, ARTIFACT 60, PRE-ACCEPT 40, RULING 30, SURROGATE 30 (the owner surrogate's ruling job), PLAN 300.

role.description: The launch configuration's role: it names the qualification receipt <KY_RUN>/QUALIFICATIONS/<role>-<model>.json that must be PASS and must bind this launch (plan §7, KV-06).

permission_mode.description: Always explicit, never inherited (the host's user settings would default it).

env.description: The job's whole environment (env -i semantics). Names and values are checked by kyboot.py against the plan §7 allowlist; JOB_SCRATCH (= job_scratch) and KY_SCRATCH (= the supervisor's resolved campaign scratch folder) are required there. This schema cannot type an open map.

extra_lean_flags.description: Flags only, each '--name' or '--name=value'; a bare word would become the prompt.

disallowed_tools.description: Tool rules passed after --disallowedTools; none may look like an option.
